text: Behaviour changes in BCApps lead the week. Posting fixes: #11998 makes journal posting check that a General Posting Setup combination exists, #12813 corrects GB reverse charge VAT sales posting for zero-quantity lines, and #12552 stops repeated production order status warnings when the "No." field is validated on a sales order. #12943 repairs Danish VAT Return Period parsing, which had inserted zero records. Localization features arrived too: #12846 adds Country/Region of Origin Code to Czech Intrastat document lines, and #9104 moves G/L entry XML export onto the Audit File Export framework as a new XML Audit File app (FR), with a page visibility interface on the format enum. #13005 adds cleanup to Master Data Management when an environment is copied; its description rates the risk low. #12186 merges consecutive ModifyAll calls, so OnModify now runs once per row where RunTrigger was passed. #12443 only renumbers Spanish SII objects. In AL-Go, #2413 enables automatic Copilot review triggers only when opted in. BCQuality dominated by volume. #246 and #155 expose and define plan guidance, and #249 adds a short-circuit cue to performance review. #231 derives the target version from app.json. New knowledge articles came in #223, #225, #226, #229, #230 and #237, and #238 improves first-run documentation.

issues: #12552 sits under the 'Posting fixes' label but is a sales line No. validation fix, not a posting fix. The description itself is accurate, only the grouping is loose.
#12443 is not flagged as a behaviour change but appears in the behaviour-change part of the paragraph. The word 'only' makes clear it is a renumbering, so this is acceptable.
